label: Fugue in C major, BWV 547
note: from the Prelude and Fugue; in five parts
caution: Read from Tobi's MusicXML file (Tobis Notenarchiv), notes, ties and names as they stand there; the voices were sorted by this program from the file's staves, stems and beams, and have not been proofread note by note. The pedal's line is the bass. The hands have four voices to themselves for two thirds of the fugue; the pedal comes in as a fifth only at bar 49, with the subject in notes twice as long.
title: Prelude and Fugue in C major, BWV 547: Fugue
procedures: a voice held back until after the exposition
